name: Why This College
note: Requires naming actual courses, programs, or professors; can't be recycled across schools without real editing.

name: Why This Major
example: UT Austin: "Why are you interested in the major you indicated?" (250-300 words)
note: Wants a connection to real experience, not just stated interest.

name: Community
example: Yale: "Reflect on your membership in a community to which you feel connected." (400 words)
note: Wants an actual group and Kyle's specific role in it.

name: Extracurricular Elaboration
example: Stanford: as short as 3-50 words in recent cycles
note: Wants depth on one listed activity, not a repeat of the activities list.

name: Diversity / Perspective
example: Princeton: "How has your lived experience shaped you?" (400-500 words)
note: Word limits on supplements vary from a few words to 650 - the workload driver on a full list is usually the supplements, not the one Common App essay.
